common_equipment_rules.unknown_module_status: Estimated fit cost; preserve item in storage if compatibility is unknown.
common_equipment_rules.laser_rules: One uniquely owned weapon controller per enabled facing. A verified multiply hull can have multiple intrinsic emitter positions for that controller: fire from each with source damage/energy/heat scaling, never duplicate inventory modules. Stingray has2; ordinary single-mount hulls1.
common_equipment_rules.missile_rules: One round per common project pylon; missile stock/variant/condition persisted; D23 native missile rack ammo remains in native data and is not substituted as hull capacity.
common_equipment_rules.baseline_transfer: Only missing intrinsic equipment is provided; forward laser and ammunition are existing uniquely owned instances on repeated swaps.
common_equipment_rules.compatibility: Common O08 equipment is permitted if slot costs and facing/pylon constraints fit. Native-edition and mission-specific items need explicit adapter compatibility; otherwise store, never destroy.
common_equipment_rules.price: Historical source prices are retained separately. Active native ship TOMLs[game].price and reviewed exchange/trade-in quotation govern purchasing; preserve those maintained values when importing source updates. Source stock/equipment does not authorize repeated exchange grants. Persistent surplus equipment storage/custody remain required.
common_equipment_rules.crew_and_passenger_contract: ship-crew-profiles.json; reserved operating crew separate from dedicated charter cabins; 5tonnes+1equipmentunit per berth; no empty-seat/free-cargo implicit passenger admission
common_equipment_rules.advanced_navigational_array_adapter: Selected O08 advanced chart/navigation equipment behaviour; estimated common cost1; not a weapon or passenger accommodation.
common_equipment_rules.cargo_bay_adapter: Estimated common equipment cost1 for actually fitted expansion module; adds only the selected hull extra hold and consumes no added hold footprint. Not granted by a theoretical expanded-hold ceiling.
common_equipment_rules.source_standard_passenger_exception: Default first-acquisition charter berth count0. SH169 Sunray native yard explicitly supplies one uniquely owned fitted berth:5tonnes+1equipmentunit reserved once. Preserve it on transfer/storage/reload and never grant another on reselection. Source seats/lore alone remain insufficient.
